state.earlier_owner_request: Bots keep moving and doing quests; on meeting a player randomly chat or befriend, form a party to do quests; bots simulate real players.
verified_facts: Production ships content/ and the server bundle, not assets/; the server cannot read voxel map files at runtime today.
A tool already loads each map's walkable grid offline (loadMapGrid in tools/world); maps are up to 800x800 core.
Precomputed route network files exist (commit 8376ca24, not deployed) built with the child's auto-walk search; owner now rejects given paths.
Production bots currently follow a player's walked trail (gather); owner rejects following players.
Bots already persist per-bot learning (skill XP) in the DB via bot-store; the server ticks bots at 10 Hz; hundreds of bots must stay cheap.
Only owner and child play now; rewards are server-computed; bots never write player progress.

sensing.instructions: What does a bot perceive of the world so it cannot walk through walls without being given paths?

criteria.walk_grid_in_content: Ship a compact per-map walkability grid (stand heights, step rules) in content/world/walk/; bots move cell by cell and only see cells within a sight radius
criteria.server_reads_voxels: Ship voxel region files to the server and compute walkability at runtime
criteria.no_sensing: No sensing; bots walk straight lines

learning.instructions: How does each bot learn its own paths and where to go?

criteria.memory_graph_rl: Each bot builds its own place graph while exploring (places it found, links it walked and their cost, shortcuts it discovers); chooses destinations with reinforcement learning (Q-values per place updated from rewards: quest done, met a player, novelty, minus walk cost), exploration rate from its persona
criteria.neural_policy: Train a neural network policy (e.g. PPO) offline in simulation and run it on the server

training.instructions: How does a bot train itself?

criteria.online_persisted_plus_sim: Learns online all the time while the server runs, memory persisted per bot in the DB; plus an offline simulation command that runs many bot-hours on a map to warm up new bots
criteria.online_only: Only online learning, persisted; new bots start knowing nothing
criteria.offline_only: Only offline training; frozen on the server

route_data_8376ca24.instructions: What to do with the precomputed route network commit (not deployed)?

criteria.revert_keep_grid_loader: Revert the route files and their test; keep the grid-loading refactor for the walk grid export
criteria.keep_as_eval: Keep routes only as a hidden benchmark to measure how well bots learned
criteria.keep_as_is: Keep routes and use them for movement

players.instructions: How do bots relate to players while moving?

criteria.perceive_and_choose: Bots never follow anyone; they notice players within sight and may choose to go meet one as a learned option (meeting is a reward), then return to their own plans
criteria.attract_to_players: Bots are always pulled to the nearest player
criteria.ignore_players: Bots ignore players unless bumped into
